who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent of the blaze-sql work
where: scripts/src/bin/smoke.rs, the cold step under a fresh BLAZE_HOME
what: The smoke quote land.py requires cannot pass for a dev-built blaze whose standard library digest is not on the release server: `hello cold` exits 101 with `getting it from https://blaze-releases.ix.dev/v0.0.0-dev failed: library-bdd582918dcd...tar.xz: the download gave up after 4 tries: not there` (branch sql-lints-1113 at b67093c4cb, blaze-vm, 2026-11-13 19:30 PST). The smoke builds each step`s environment from nothing and does not set BLAZE_LIBRARY, and the fixture is outside the checkout, so the tree`s own library/ is never found.
cost: The lint fixes for the SQL crates could not be landed; about 40 minutes over five VM runs.
cause: Not confirmed: which step publishes a dev library tarball, and whether it ran for this digest, was not found in the tree.
class: a required proof depends on an artifact published out of band, so a merge can be blocked by a publish that did not happen
prevention: the smoke passes the tree`s library/ (BLAZE_LIBRARY) to its steps, since the quote already names that tree; not built
workaround: none found that keeps the guard
